summary: Wrap a Promise-returning function in Node error-first callback form with asynchronous callback delivery.

target.notes: Reuse existing function invocation and Promise/microtask semantics; do not implement a second Promise model.

semantics.signature: returned function appends an error-first callback argument
semantics.falsy_rejection: wrapped in Error whose reason property stores the original falsy value
semantics.this_binding: wrapper must forward this and ordinary arguments

caveats: Calling the callback inline changes ordering.
A callback throw occurs asynchronously and can surface as uncaughtException.
